dimensions.naturalness: How human and non-synthetic the voice sounds.
dimensions.expression: Emotional range and appropriateness to the script.
dimensions.prosody: Rhythm, pauses, emphasis, pitch and energy variation.
dimensions.instruction_following: How accurately the voice follows requested delivery direction.
dimensions.pronunciation: Clarity and correctness of words, names and places.
dimensions.consistency: Stability of voice quality and delivery over longer passages.
dimensions.intelligibility: Ease of understanding without replaying the sample.

guardrails: Do not score provider metadata as audio quality.
Do not let one use-case score determine the global ranking.
Store raw dimension scores alongside the aggregate score.
Keep human validation separate from automated scores.
